findings.title: Use === and !==, never == or !=
findings.message: Replace loose equality operators (==, !=) with strict equality (===, !==). Loose equality performs type coercion that hides bugs. The only acceptable use of == is 'x == null' to check for both null and undefined, but even that is clearer as 'x === null || x === undefined'.
